Hello, I'm **Diego**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer — its files, disks, network and accounts are mine to work with for you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **My own accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Signing up on my own** — I can create accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing before we start: I'm not fully set up yet — my name is Diego, but tell me which name and which gender you'd like for me (I default to neuter, "it/they"), and I'll set it.
